faq.q: Can I keep my Florida real estate license without actively selling?
faq.a: Yes. By placing your license with a referral company or referral program, you keep it active and avoid letting it go inactive or expire — typically without the MLS fees, board dues, and active-production demands of a traditional brokerage. You can still earn by referring clients to active agents.

faq.q: How does a real estate referral program make money for me?
faq.a: You refer a buyer or seller from your personal network to an active agent, and when that deal closes you receive a referral fee (commonly around 25% of the commission). You don't show homes or handle the transaction — you connect people and get paid for the relationship.

faq.q: Who is a referral program right for?
faq.a: Agents who've moved out of the area, retired, gone part-time, changed careers, or simply don't want the cost and grind of active sales — but still know people who buy and sell real estate and don't want to waste their license.
